description: Land Title Settlement Department - Dehipagoda, Udunuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320241
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, locations, ownership details, and title classifications) in various villages and divisions. The content focuses entirely on land ownership, title settlement, and property registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
